title: Chapter 689 - 689 Buy; Curse!

Chapter 689 - 689 Buy; Curse!

Chapter 689 - 689 Buy; Curse!

689 Buy; Curse!

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng walked on Daluo Street.

There were many stalls and shops here.

There were all kinds of weapons, armors, high-tech weapons that had the advantage in battles, and pills that emitted a strange fragrance… There were even powerful cultivator slaves and graceful women for sale.

It could be said that Daluo Street had everything that anyone needed.

At this moment, Ma Zheng suddenly stopped in his tracks. His gaze fell on a slightly old spear in a stall not far away.

The short and thin old man sitting in front of the stall also noticed this. He glanced at Ma Zheng from the corner of his eye and said leisurely, “This gun was once the weapon of a Planet level warrior. Although it has suffered some wear and tear, it’s still very sharp and tough. It only costs 30 stones.”

“Can I take a look?” Ma Zheng asked after pondering for a moment.

“Sure,” the short and skinny old man said.

Lin Fan looked at the spear and then looked around curiously.

At this moment, a crisp notification suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Heavenly Soul Pearl detected.]

[Heavenly Soul Pearl: An Emperor-level treasure. It has the special power to continuously nurture and protect the soul.]

Then, Lin Fan’s gaze landed on a broken stone in the stall.

However, he quickly looked at the other items.

He understood that the more he expressed his desire to buy, the higher the price would be.

Therefore, he casually asked about the price of a few items.

Finally, he casually asked the Heavenly Soul Pearl on the ground.

“A stone found underground, one spirit crystal,” the short and thin old man said casually.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, I’ll buy it.”

The short and thin old man was a little bewildered.

Could it be that this stone was a treasure?

Did he underbid?

The short and thin elder sized up the Heavenly Soul Pearl carefully, but he did not discover anything unusual at all.

Thus, he could only nod.

“Wait!”

Not far away, an ear-piercing sound suddenly sounded.

Then, Qin Dachuan, who had a mustache, walked over.

“I’m willing to pay five spirit crystals for this stone!”

Then, he grinned and said, “Friend, I’m sorry, but I also think this stone is quite good!

“This spear is not bad as well. I’m willing to pay 35 stones.”

Then, he said to the short and thin old man, “You haven’t made a deal yet, right? There shouldn’t be a problem with my bid, right?”

How could the short and thin old man not understand that Qin Dachuan might have a grudge against the two people in front of him and was deliberately here to bicker?

However, what did that have to do with him?

As long as he could sell the items for a better price.

He could not be happier!

“Of course not!” The short and thin old man immediately smiled.

Ma Zheng’s expression turned extremely ugly.

He liked this weapon very much. If he wanted to buy it now, he would probably have to pay more.

Lin Fan frowned and said, “Six spirit crystals.”

“Eight spirit crystals,” Qin Dachuan said with a smile. “I’m sorry. I really like this stone.”

“Ten stones,” Lin Fan said.

“Twelve stones,” Qin Dachuan said.

“Fifteen stones,” Lin Fan said.

“Since you like it so much, then I won’t snatch it away from you.” Qin Dachuan sneered.

Then, he said to Ma Zheng, “Thirty-five spirit crystals. If you don’t offer a higher price, I’ll take this weapon!”

“Forty spirit crystals!” Ma Zheng said in a deep voice.

Qin Dachuan laughed and said, “I’ll let you have it!”

Then, he walked into the distance in a carefree manner.

Lin Fan looked at Qin Dachuan’s back and narrowed his eyes.

“Senior Lin, fighting is forbidden on Daluo Street,” Ma Zheng hurriedly said.

“I understand.” Lin Fan nodded.

After Lin Fan paid the 15 spirit crystals, a crisp notification sounded out in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve spent more than ten spirit crystals. Congratulations, you’ve obtained Emperor-level Sword Nurturing Technique.]

[Emperor-level Sword Nurturing Technique: An emperor-level skill. Continue to infuse power into the sword to nourish it. When it kills the enemy, it’ll instantly release power, producing endless terrifying power.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

The accumulated power exploded instantly!

This was definitely a good skill to catch the enemy off guard and kill them.

Then, the two of them continued to stroll around.

In the meantime, Lin Fan found an Emperor-level broken sword, a Flame Crystal, and a Life Cleansing Bottle, which cost him a total of 60 spirit crystals.

At the same time, he gained a better understanding of the universe.

After Lin Fan returned to the hotel suite, he first picked up the rusty broken sword and unsealed it according to the system’s instructions. Then, he gently touched the stone table in front of him.

The stone table broke into two like tofu.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but exclaim, “This is an Emperor-level weapon? Amazing!”

Then, he looked at the Life Cleansing Bottle and released the restriction according to the system notification. He saw a pool of white liquid with extremely strong life force inside.

Lin Fan took in a deep breath, and his entire body felt extremely relaxed. All the pores on his body opened up.

“As long as I’m still alive, I’ll probably be able to recover to my peak state immediately after drinking a drop!” Lin Fan praised.

Lin Fan then took out the Flame Crystal.

It was a dark red stone.

Lin Fan followed the system notification’s instructions and slowly unsealed it.

He had only undid it a little when the temperature of the entire suite shot up. The air suddenly distorted and smoke gradually rose.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan hurriedly sealed it once more.

“What a terrifying temperature!” he exclaimed in shock. “What pure flame energy! When I find a new place to unseal it tomorrow, it’ll definitely be able to greatly increase the power of fire in my five elements!”

As Lin Fan said this, he became extremely excited.

Now, he had some understanding of the spirit crystals and treasures in the universe.

Regardless of whether it was the Life Cleansing Bottle, the broken Emperor-level sword, or the Flame Crystal, any of them could be sold for tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of spirit crystals.

He only spent 50 stones!

The system was truly amazing!

Finally, Lin Fan took out the Heavenly Soul Pearl. After unsealing it, he immediately let it recognize him as its master.

Instantly, Lin Fan’s soul had an additional sturdy protective shield.

At the same time, his soul was also nourished by a mysterious force. It was constantly condensing and becoming stronger. It was very comfortable.

After doing all of this, Qin Dachuan’s figure appeared in Lin Fan’s mind.

The Heavenly Soul Pearl was definitely a very good treasure.

Originally, the Heavenly Soul Pearl only cost one spirit crystal.

In the end, Qin Dachuan had to spend 15 spirit crystals.

More importantly, if Qin Dachuan had caused trouble and attracted the attention of others, such a wondrous Heavenly Soul Pearl might not have even reached his hands.

At the thought of this, Lin Fan’s face turned cold as he focused his attention on Curse.

[Do you want to use spirit crystals to curse Qin Dachuan?]

“Yes!”

In the next moment, a spirit crystal in Lin Fan’s hand shattered into dust and disappeared.
